sources.topic: nearby piece lookup and compact indexes
incremental completion filtering and scoring policy

method.fleet: Final candidate, including 16-bit indexes: ABBA fresh Electron processes for local Tree-sitter symbols (38 explicit packages) and real LSP (43). Both require a complete 195778-symbol cache with Outline closed. Two openings per process, middle and 100 rows before EOF, 60 characters then 180 wheel events and six seconds observation. Sources are frozen. Input is never copied or saved; output and syntax revision/input/extent/error-state checks agree.
method.locality: ABBA Electron Node processes. 200000 lineStart calls per lookup condition, or 5000 edits with three coordinate reads. Fresh and 2000-edit-fragmented trees; checksums match the flat offset oracle.
method.lifetime: ABBA renderer processes using the actual completion runtime and native AbortController. 500 settled or pending requests; pending requests still cancel exactly 500 times. This isolates lifecycle bookkeeping, not layout/RPC.
method.memory: ABBA fresh Electron Node processes. An instrumented copy of the unchanged module counts actual byteLength allocated by Uint16Array.from/Uint32Array.from. Values remain native typed arrays. This measures index-array payload, not RSS or total heap. Embedded Electron reports zero for memoryUsage().arrayBuffers, so the initial counter-based pilot is excluded.
method.limits: Windows only; descriptive samples from two processes per condition/variant, no population-tail claim. The initial 32-bit-cache pilot is excluded from final fleet results. No measurable whole-typing acceleration is claimed from these smaller changes. The expensive active parser/LSP cancellation path remains separate.
